commentary.text: 90+5' Ruddy Buquet is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Ruddy Buquet and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ruddy Buquet had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

90+2' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Donovan Leon stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
88' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Josue Casimir (Auxerre), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
86' Auxerre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
83' Substitution. Ryan Rodin (Auxerre) on for Lassine Sinayoko.

79' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Donovan Leon (Auxerre). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
